_comment: Timed on-screen messages for clip.html. Each key is a YouTube video ID — the 11 characters after v= in the address. 't' is seconds into the video (absolute, not relative to the clip start); each line stays up until the next one. The key must exactly match the ?v= value in the OptiSigns asset URL, or the video plays with no text. Add &pos=top to the URL for any ad that has its own text along the bottom.

gviLtf5jq14.note: Solensia / feline OA (Zoetis) — before-and-after cats. Asset URL: clip.html?v=gviLtf5jq14&start=20&end=144&cc=0&pos=top. Duration 124s. Captions moved to the top because the ad carries its own lower-third text. Cue times are estimates — watch once and nudge them.
